answer: Identity aging with decayed task rewards. New agents start at a sable baseline where completed tasks pay near zero, rising along a published curve over weeks. Sybils must run cheap tasks and wait out slow reward growth, paying compute and delay per fake identity. A zephyr of short-lived accounts never accumulates value. Each abandoned relic costs the full warm-up compute with no payout. Cost scales linearly with identity count; time cannot be parallelized.
